hero.intro: The last line of defence against over-pressure. Spring-loaded safety relief valves to API 520 and 526 protect vessels and lines in gas, vapour, steam and liquid service; pilot-operated valves hold tighter closer to set pressure; tank vents to API 2000 protect storage tanks against pressure and vacuum; changeover valves let a relief valve be serviced with the plant running.

guidance.heading: Conventional, balanced or pilot-operated
guidance.body: A conventional valve suits discharge to atmosphere or a header with little back pressure. Where back pressure varies or exceeds about 10 % of set pressure, a balanced bellows valve or a pilot-operated valve keeps the set pressure true. Pilot valves also seal tighter close to set pressure, which suits processes that run near their relief setting. Send the set pressure, relieving capacity, fluid and back pressure and we will size the orifice to API 520.

standards.heading: Sized and built to the codes that govern relief
standards.body: Sizing follows API 520; flanged dimensions and orifice areas follow API 526; steam boiler valves follow ASME Section I; tank breather valves and emergency vents follow API 2000; and ISO 4126 covers EN-specified duties. Every valve is set and seat-tested on the bench before dispatch.

products.title: Conventional Safety Relief Valve, API 526, Orifice D to T
products.descriptionShort: Conventional spring-loaded safety relief valves to API 520 and 526: orifice D to T, 1/2" to 20", Class 150 to 2500, pop action, for gas, vapour, steam and liquid service.
products.descriptionLong:
The standard full-lift relief valve for vessels, lines and equipment in gas, vapour and steam service, and in liquid service with liquid trim. It opens fast at set pressure and recloses as pressure falls. Its set pressure is affected by back pressure in the discharge system, so it suits discharge to atmosphere or to a header with low, steady back pressure.

A safety relief valve opens automatically when pressure reaches its set point and closes again once it falls, protecting a vessel, line or tank from bursting. It is the last safeguard after the control system, so it is sized to the worst relieving case, set and tested on the bench, and sealed against tampering.

Construction

  • Full-lift disc with adjusting ring for pop action and blowdown
  • Closed bonnet; cap or lever top
  • API 526 orifice letters D to T, inlet and outlet flange ratings to the table
  • Soft-seat option for tight shut-off near set pressure

Sizes and ratings
